raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

GLM-5.3-Flash uses `IndexerKPool`, so the non-pooled indexer optimization in #30715 does not apply to it. Its query path separately launches Hadamard rotation and FP8 quantization in every DSA layer; dual-stream decode also launches two elementwise operations to apply the head-gate scale.

This ports that fusion to `IndexerKPool`. The intended benefit is fewer kernel launches and one fewer BF16 intermediate round-trip, not an end-to-end throughput claim.

Component launch profile on MI355X/gfx950:

| path | fusion off | fusion on |
|---|---:|---:|
| prefill | 2 launches | 1 launch |
| dual-stream decode | 4 launches | 1 launch |

## Modifications

- Add `fused_hadamard_act_quant`, a Triton kernel combining the query-side Walsh-Hadamard transform and block FP8 quantization.
- Preserve the production BF16 materialization boundary inside the fused kernel so `ue8m0` scales match the two-pass path exactly.
- Fold `weights * q_scale * softmax_scale` into the fused kernel when dual-stream decode has precomputed head-gate weights.
- Wire the kernel only into `IndexerKPool`; the non-pooled `Indexer` remains unchanged.
- Keep the existing path as the default and fallback. The fused path requires `SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_HADAMARD_QUANT=1`, ROCm gfx950, a power-of-two head dimension, and `head_dim == block_size`.
- Add gfx950 tests covering GLM-5.3-Flash geometry `(M, 32, 128)`, `M={1,64,4096,16384}`, two seeds, `ue8m0` and unrounded scales, production two-pass parity, folded weights, finite outputs, and CUDA graph replay.

## Accuracy Tests

Full GLM-5.3-Flash Quark MXFP4 GSM8K on snapshot `b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07`, integrated source `79f15c7f86` containing #38764 at `ed418ce926`, #41615 at `acca6a72db`, and #44661 at `8eb1931ec5`. Both arms use `aiter_sparse_mla`, `SGLANG_OPT_GLM53_KDA_PTPC_MODULES=qkv_proj,f_a_proj,g_a_proj,o_proj`, AITER `e7d2453f25`, separate fresh caches, thinking enabled, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, and seed 0.

| Configuration | Score | Stop rate | Truncated rate | Error rate |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| TP4 fusion off — `SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_HADAMARD_QUANT=0` | 97.35% | 100.00% | 0.00% | 0.00% |
| TP4 fusion on — `SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_HADAMARD_QUANT=1` | 96.89% | 99.92% | 0.08% | 0.00% |
| TP8 fusion off — `SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_HADAMARD_QUANT=0` | 97.35% | 99.77% | 0.23% | 0.00% |
| TP8 fusion on — `SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_HADAMARD_QUANT=1` | 96.66% | 99.62% | 0.38% | 0.00% |

TP4 used a 65,536-token context, 64 evaluator threads, and 32,768 maximum output tokens. TP8 used a 131,072-token context, 1,200 evaluator threads, and 4,096 maximum output tokens. All four runs completed 1,319 questions without errors; the score deltas are within single-pass sampling variation.

Focused validation: fused-kernel suite **3 passed**; KPool stream scheduling suite **13 passed**.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Serving-relevant CUDA-graph replay of the query transform, FP8 quantization, and folded head-weight scaling component on MI355X/gfx950. Times are medians in microseconds; every enabled cell beats the fallback.

| M | fusion off (µs) | fusion on (µs) | delta |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 16.05 | 9.28 | -42.18% |
| 2 | 15.96 | 9.23 | -42.14% |
| 4 | 16.15 | 9.38 | -41.90% |
| 8 | 16.58 | 9.25 | -44.18% |
| 16 | 16.69 | 9.28 | -44.41% |
| 32 | 16.59 | 9.26 | -44.20% |
| 64 | 16.92 | 9.33 | -44.83% |
| 128 | 16.97 | 9.26 | -45.43% |
| 256 | 17.35 | 9.29 | -46.42% |
| 512 | 21.85 | 9.60 | -56.07% |
| 1,024 | 30.21 | 11.01 | -63.55% |

These are component timings only.

nodes.body:
`getattr(self, "fuse_hadamard_quant", False)` (here and twice in `_get_q_k_bf16`) and `IndexerKPool._quant_query(self, ...)` at the four call sites exist only so the `SimpleNamespace` stubs in `test_kpool_stream_scheduling.py` keep working. A real `IndexerKPool` always sets the attribute, so the default only hides a rename: if one site drifts, q skips the Hadamard while K keeps it and accuracy drops silently. Please use `self.fuse_hadamard_quant` / `self._quant_query(...)` and update the stubs, as the file already does for `_can_overlap_prefill`:

```python
indexer = SimpleNamespace(..., fuse_hadamard_quant=False)
indexer._quant_query = MethodType(IndexerKPool._quant_query, indexer)
```

+"""Fused Walsh-Hadamard transform + block fp8 quant for the DSA indexer query.
+
+Replaces the two-pass `act_quant(rotate_activation(q))` (hadamard writes a bf16
+tensor, then act_quant reads it back and quantizes) with a single kernel: the
+post-hadamard row stays in registers and is quantized in place, removing one
+bf16 round-trip of the query per layer.
+
+The hadamard is done as a matmul against the +/-1 Sylvester matrix (accumulated
+in fp32) then scaled by 1/sqrt(N) -- numerically equivalent to
+`fast_hadamard_transform(x, scale=N**-0.5)`. The quant matches tilelang
+`act_quant`: block-wise (group=128) absmax, s = max(absmax, 1e-4)/fp8_max
+(round_scale when scale_fmt is set), e4m3fn output + fp32 scale.
+"""
+
+from functools import lru_cache
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.fp8_kernel import is_fp8_fnuz
+
+_IS_FNUZ = is_fp8_fnuz()
+_FP8_DTYPE = torch.float8_e4m3fnuz if _IS_FNUZ else torch.float8_e4m3fn
+_FP8_MAX = 224.0 if _IS_FNUZ else 448.0
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=4)
+def _hadamard_pm1(n: int, device: str, dtype: torch.dtype) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """+/-1 Sylvester (natural-order) Hadamard matrix [n, n]."""
+    h = torch.ones(1, 1, dtype=torch.float32)
+    while h.shape[0] < n:
+        h = torch.cat([torch.cat([h, h], dim=1), torch.cat([h, -h], dim=1)], dim=0)
+    assert h.shape[0] == n, "n must be a power of 2"
+    return h.to(device=device, dtype=dtype)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _hadamard_quant_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    h_ptr,
+    y_ptr,
+    s_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    wo_ptr,
+    M,
+    inv_sqrt_n,
+    fp8_max,
+    fp8_min,
+    softmax_scale,
+    ROUND_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    FUSE_WEIGHTS: tl.constexpr,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    rows = pid * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    rmask = rows < M
+    n = tl.arange(0, N)
+
+    x = tl.load(
+        x_ptr + rows[:, None] * N + n[None, :], mask=rmask[:, None], other=0.0
+    ).to(h_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+    h = tl.load(h_ptr + n[:, None] * N + n[None, :])
+
+    # The production two-pass path materializes the Hadamard result as BF16
+    # before quantization. Preserve that boundary so ue8m0 scale buckets and
+    # FP8 bytes match at values adjacent to a power-of-two threshold.
+    had = (tl.dot(x, h).to(tl.float32) * inv_sqrt_n).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+
+    amax = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.abs(had), axis=1), 1e-4)
+    if ROUND_SCALE:
+        s = tl.exp2(tl.ceil(tl.log2(amax / fp8_max)))
+    else:
+        s = amax / fp8_max
+    y = tl.clamp(had / s[:, None], fp8_min, fp8_max).to(y_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+
+    tl.store(y_ptr + rows[:, None] * N + n[None, :], y, mask=rmask[:, None])
+    tl.store(s_ptr + rows, s, mask=rmask)
+
+    if FUSE_WEIGHTS:
+        w = tl.load(w_ptr + rows, mask=rmask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        tl.store(wo_ptr + rows, w * s * softmax_scale, mask=rmask)
+
+
+def fused_hadamard_act_quant(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    block_size: int = 128,
+    scale_fmt: Optional[str] = None,
+    weights: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    softmax_scale: float = 1.0,
+):
+    """Fuse Hadamard rotation and block FP8 quantization.
+
+    The last dimension must be one power-of-two quantization group. If
+    ``weights`` is supplied, also return ``weights * scale * softmax_scale``.
+    """
+    assert x.is_contiguous(), "input must be contiguous"
+    n = x.size(-1)
+    assert n == block_size, "fused path requires head_dim == block_size"
+    assert (n & (n - 1)) == 0, "head_dim must be a power of 2"
+
+    y = torch.empty_like(x, dtype=_FP8_DTYPE)
+    s = x.new_empty(*x.size()[:-1], 1, dtype=torch.float32)
+    x2 = x.view(-1, n)
+    m = x2.shape[0]
+    h = _hadamard_pm1(n, str(x.device), torch.bfloat16)
+
+    fuse_weights = weights is not None
+    if fuse_weights:
+        assert weights.shape == x.shape[:-1], (
+            f"weights {tuple(weights.shape)} must match "
+            f"x.shape[:-1] {tuple(x.shape[:-1])}"
+        )
+        w_in = weights.contiguous().view(-1)
+        w_out = torch.empty(m, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    else:
+        w_in = x2
+        w_out = s.view(-1)
+
+    block_m = 32
+    _hadamard_quant_kernel[(triton.cdiv(m, block_m),)](
+        x2,
+        h,
+        y.view(-1, n),
+        s.view(-1),
+        w_in,
+        w_out,
+        m,
+        float(n) ** -0.5,
+        _FP8_MAX,
+        -_FP8_MAX,
+        float(softmax_scale),
+        ROUND_SCALE=scale_fmt is not None,
+        FUSE_WEIGHTS=fuse_weights,
+        N=n,
+        BLOCK_M=block_m,
+    )
+    if fuse_weights:
+        return y, s, w_out.view(*weights.shape, 1)
+    return y, s

+"""Correctness tests for fused DSA query Hadamard and FP8 quantization."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsa.triton_hadamard_quant import (
+    _FP8_DTYPE,
+    fused_hadamard_act_quant,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.act_quant_tilelang import act_quant
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.dsa_indexer import rotate_activation
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported, is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# backend-specific: exercises the gfx950 FP8 FNUZ and TileLang reference path.
+register_amd_ci(
+    est_time=180,
+    stage="stage-b",
+    runner_config="1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x",
+)
+
+_BLOCK = 128
+_HEADS = 32
+_ROWS = (1, 64, 4096, 16384)
+_SEEDS = (0, 41)
+
+
+def _production_reference(x: torch.Tensor, scale_fmt):
+    return act_quant(rotate_activation(x), _BLOCK, scale_fmt)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    torch.cuda.is_available() and is_hip() and is_gfx95_supported(),
+    "requires one gfx950 GPU",
+)
+class TestFusedHadamardActQuant(CustomTestCase):
+    def _input(self, rows, seed):
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+        return (
+            torch.randn(
+                rows,
+                _HEADS,
+                _BLOCK,
+                device="cuda",
+                dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                generator=generator,
+            )
+            * 0.3
+        ).contiguous()
+
+    def _assert_quantized_close(self, y, scale, y_ref, scale_ref):
+        self.assertEqual(y.dtype, _FP8_DTYPE)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(y.float()).all().item())
+        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(scale).all().item())
+
+        dequant = y.float() * scale
+        dequant_ref = y_ref.float() * scale_ref
+        cosine = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
+            dequant.flatten(), dequant_ref.flatten(), dim=0
+        ).item()
+        self.assertGreater(cosine, 0.999)
+
+        exact = (y.view(torch.uint8) == y_ref.view(torch.uint8)).float().mean().item()
+        self.assertGreater(exact, 0.95)
+
+    def test_matches_production_two_pass(self):
+        for rows in _ROWS:
+            for seed in _SEEDS:
+                for scale_fmt in (None, "ue8m0"):
+                    with self.subTest(rows=rows, seed=seed, scale_fmt=scale_fmt):
+                        x = self._input(rows, seed)
+                        y, scale = fused_hadamard_act_quant(x, _BLOCK, scale_fmt)
+                        y_ref, scale_ref = _production_reference(x, scale_fmt)
+                        if scale_fmt == "ue8m0":
+                            torch.testing.assert_close(scale, scale_ref, rtol=0, atol=0)
+                        else:
+                            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                                scale, scale_ref, rtol=1e-2, atol=0
+                            )
+                        self._assert_quantized_close(y, scale, y_ref, scale_ref)
+
+    def test_weights_fold(self):
+        softmax_scale = _BLOCK**-0.5
+        for rows in (1, 64, 4096):
+            for seed in _SEEDS:
+                with self.subTest(rows=rows, seed=seed):
+                    x = self._input(rows, seed)
+                    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed + 1)
+                    weights = torch.randn(
+                        rows,
+                        _HEADS,
+                        device="cuda",
+                        dtype=torch.float32,
+                        generator=generator,
+                    )
+                    y, scale, scaled_weights = fused_hadamard_act_quant(
+                        x,
+                        _BLOCK,
+                        "ue8m0",
+                        weights=weights,
+                        softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
+                    )
+                    expected = weights.unsqueeze(-1) * scale * softmax_scale
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        scaled_weights, expected, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-7
+                    )
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(y.float()).all().item())
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(scaled_weights).all().item())
+
+    def test_cuda_graph_replay(self):
+        x = self._input(64, 7)
+        weights = torch.randn(
+            64, _HEADS, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32
+        ).contiguous()
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+
+        fused_hadamard_act_quant(x, _BLOCK, "ue8m0", weights=weights)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            y, scale, scaled_weights = fused_hadamard_act_quant(
+                x, _BLOCK, "ue8m0", weights=weights
+            )
+
+        expected = None
+        for seed in _SEEDS:
+            x.copy_(self._input(64, seed))
+            graph.replay()
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            current = (y.clone(), scale.clone(), scaled_weights.clone())
+            eager = fused_hadamard_act_quant(x, _BLOCK, "ue8m0", weights=weights)
+            for actual, reference in zip(current, eager):
+                torch.testing.assert_close(actual, reference, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            if expected is not None:
+                self.assertFalse(torch.equal(current[0], expected[0]))
+            expected = current
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
